episodes.title: Iron and Blood
episodes.summary: Orga's team is picked to escort Kudelia, the leader of the Martian independence movement to Earth for a important meeting. While preparations for departure are being made, the base is attacked by Gjallarhorn.

episodes.title: Barbatos
episodes.summary: The adults flee when Gjallarhorn attacks, using Mikazuki and the rest as decoys. Orga gathers those who have been left behind and makes the decision to fight back putting a secret plan into action.

episodes.title: Beyond the Red Sky
episodes.summary: Tekkadan and Kudelia leave Mars behind; They're attacked by Coral's Gjallarhorn forces when they try to catch a shuttle.

episodes.title: A Letter from Tomorrow
episodes.summary: Tekkadan and Turbines leave Mikazuki and Yikinojo on the Saisei to finish final adjustments to the Barbatos.

episodes.title: Human Debris
episodes.summary: While on patrol, Akihiro and Takaki are attacked by unknown enemies and they engage them in battle.

episodes.title: Funeral Rites
episodes.summary: The survivors of the battle with the Brewers hold a funeral service for their fallen comrades.

episodes.title: Fumitan Admoss
episodes.summary: The colony workers launch a protest movement, which develops into a Gjallarhorn intervention; Kudelia is drawn into the uprising.

episodes.title: Kudelia's Decision
episodes.summary: After Kudelia witnesses Gjallarhorn's brutality, she makes a fateful decision.

episodes.title: Voice
episodes.summary: Tekkandan's members try to depart the colonies to finally descend to Earthl; someone claims to support the members.

episodes.title: The Gravity of Wishes
episodes.summary: With Gjallarhorn's fleet blocking a path, Tekkandan tries to descend to Earth, but the ensuing battle becomes fierce.

episodes.title: Brother
episodes.summary: Tekkada will have to accompany Makanai to a parliamentary general session taking place in Edmonton.

episodes.title: To the Place of Return
episodes.summary: As they prepare to return to Edmonton, Tekkadan falls under attack by Gjallarhorn; Orga makes a counterattack.

episodes.title: Not Yet Home
episodes.summary: Exhausted by the repeated battles with Gjallarhorn forces, Tekkadan members are still determined to go to Edmonton.

episodes.title: The Final Lie
episodes.summary: Tekkadan heads to Edmonton, but the way is blocked by Carta who is seeking a showdown; Mikazuki and the others keep pressing on.

episodes.title: A Future Reward
episodes.summary: Orga and other members finally reach Edmonton, but are attacked by Gjallarhorn.

episodes.title: Tekkadan
episodes.summary: A threat appears during the battle between Tekkadan and Gjallarhorn, Mikazuki ends up confronting the new threat alone and makes a discovery.

episodes.title: New Blood
episodes.summary: Space pirates attack Tekkadan as they try to escort Kudelia on an inspection of a halfmetal mine.

episodes.title: In the Midst of Jealousy
episodes.summary: Tekkadan fight odd space pirates, but quickly realize they were part of a bigger group.

episodes.title: Battle Before Dawn
episodes.summary: Deploying all the fighting strength it possibly can, Tekkadan attempts to capture Sandoval Reuters, the leader of the Dawn Horizon Corps. During a hard fight against unequal odds, Gjallarhorn's outer lunar orbit joint fleet Arianrhod also joins the battle.

episodes.title: The Trigger of Promotion
episodes.summary: Mikazuki and Orga visit the leader of the ideological group 'Terra Liberionis' to resolve the issues surrounding the attacks of the 'Dawn Horizon Corps'.

episodes.title: Inauguration of the Arbrau Defense Forces
episodes.summary: Tekkadan who is now serving as a military advisor to Arbaru, is consumed with preparing the launch ceremony for the Arbrau Defense Forces. At Makanai's request, Tekkadan takes charge of security for the ceremony event.

episodes.title: Silent War
episodes.summary: A conflict between the rival econic blocs of Arbrau and Sau breaks out as their armies clash on the Balfour Plain.

episodes.title: Stained Wings
episodes.summary: The awakened mobile armor, along with a huge quantity of sub-units of the ancient armor head for a densely populated area to fulfill their ancient programing.

episodes.title: Battle for Chryse
episodes.summary: Outnumbered, the Tekkadan turn to McGillis for assistance and launch a mobile armor mop up operation.

episodes.title: Revealed Intentions
episodes.summary: Gjallarhorn's Earth HQ is captured in a coup d'etat by young officers.

episodes.title: The Man Who Holds the Soul
